description:
Native agent CLIs manager with Ghostty terminals, an embedded browser, and an IDE.

Ghostex is an all-in-one native agents workspace: agent chats, a code editor, and a browser for every agent CLI and subscription you have, in one fast native window built with Rust and GPUI.

Features:
- A real chat for every agent — thinking, tool calls, and file edits fold into tidy cards, diffs are readable, images are clickable, and prompts queue while the agent works. It is still the agent's own CLI underneath, and the raw terminal is one hotkey away.
- Coordinators that run the work — tell a coordinator what needs doing and it hands each piece to a thread it starts, briefs, and keeps track of, in its own Git worktree when threads should run in parallel.
- Multiple Claude and Codex accounts with automatic failover when limits are hit.
- Remote access to your machines via phone pairing or Tailscale.
- Optional plugins for Linear, Jira, GitHub, Sentry, and more.
macOS: Apple Silicon DMG · Windows: PowerShell irm https://ghostex.dev/install.ps1 | iex · x64 installer · ARM64 installer (if Windows says it protected your PC, click More info, then Run anyway; the publisher is Open Source Developer Mohamad Yahia Youssef)
Linux x64: .deb · .rpm · tarball (mise/ubi) · AppImage · AUR (ghostex-bin) · Linux ARM64: .deb · .rpm · tarball · AppImage
Android: APK · iOS: App Store
12.5.0 - 2026-11-28
Ghostex 12.5.0 is out. macOS 15 is now the minimum, the built-in browser moves to Chromium 158 with its security fixes, projects can span several repos, chats without a project get their own home in No project, Canvas is built in, Quick Access finds chats by what was said in them, one Triage Boost covers issues, pull requests and messages, coordinators warn before their accounts run out, and the voice agent knows your sessions from the start.
⚠️ macOS 15 is now required
- Ghostex 12.5.0 needs macOS 15 Sequoia or newer. Macs on macOS 13 or 14 are not offered this update and keep 12.4.0; upgrade macOS to get 12.5.0 and later.
🔒 Security
- The built-in browser moves to CEF 158 (Chromium 158.0.8127.89) with Chrome 158's security fixes, a critical sandbox escape among them. Pages that still rely on XSLT stop working, as they do in Chrome 158, thanks to @itzmail.
📁 Projects and chats
- A project can span several repos: a folder of repos, a repo whose .code-workspace lists other folders, or a repo with submodules. Changes groups the files under each repo, one "Commit N repos" commits them all, "Merge every repo" merges each one into its own default branch, and new worktrees, Rename and Delete cover every repo, on the computer and the phone.
- Chats without a project live in No project, with a New Chat row that shows even while it is empty; Cmd+N starts there. Move to project in a No project chat's menu moves it into a project: Claude and Codex chats carry on in place, other agents get a handover. --no-project does the same from the CLI. On the computer, the browser build and the phone.
- Main Hub is now Ghostex AI, with one row per computer named after it and Autopilot folded in its own section. Its header starts no sessions; chats you started there move to No project once.
- Quick Access finds chats by what was said in them, not only by their titles, best match first, with the matching words under each chat. The phone's Sessions search does too.
🎨 Canvas
- Canvas is built in: Open a view > Canvas draws sketches and diagrams on a board, saved as .excalidraw files in each project's .ghostex/drawings folder (~/.ghostex/drawings for No project). The tab's chevron switches, renames, deletes and adds drawings or includes one in git, and Files shows the drawings folder. Boards from the Community Canvas extension move there by themselves and the extension retires. Settings > Extensions > Hide Canvas view turns it off.
🚀 Boosts
- One Triage Boost for issues, pull requests and messages: a single Live page with a Requests section and a Messages section and a decision per item. It asks which sources to read the first time, remembers them on this computer, and *Triage github or *Triage all except slack overrides them for one run.
- Side by side is now Options, tuned from the Live page Boost, and it can ask more than one question.
- A Filter Boosts field tops the chat box's Boost menu, focused as it opens, with Up, Down and Enter to pick one.
- The Browser use Boost sends website tasks to OpenCode Browse in your own signed-in browser; Computer use is for desktop apps on Cua Driver.
🧭 Coordinators and accounts
- A coordinator warns before its account runs out when no other account could take over: at 70%, 85% and 95%, its chat shows a card that says why (for example, #4 and #5 aren't signed in here), with a Needs you item, a notification and a phone push. Not now hides it until the next step.
- The out-of-usage card says why an account switch failed, naming the accounts that need to sign in again, and its choices sit in one "Choose what to do" menu that fits a narrow chat and the phone. ghostex coordinator status names those accounts too.
- A coordinator no longer runs twice on busy servers (#786): Close, Sleep and Wake stop a session's lost background copy, and Ghostex never starts a second one.
- Calls to another computer say which side was slow, and a thread start that finishes late still links to its coordinator and gets its brief (#789). A thread whose agent can't start shows the agent's own error.
💬 Chat
- Native Claude gets Chrome tools when Claude Code has Chrome on by default (#790), a Claude chat's Mode menu has a "Claude in Chrome" switch that restarts Claude once it is idle, and --chrome starts a chat with it.
- Sub-agents' text stays out of the main reply in Native Codex and Claude chats, Codex sub-agent counts survive a resume, and Claude's background agents show in the chat (#791).
- Copy on select for chat messages (Settings > Chat, off by default) copies the text you select, keeping code's indentation, thanks to @roypadina.
- Native chats no longer sleep: Ghostex stops an idle Native chat's agent after 10 minutes (longer while you look at it, never while background work runs), and your next message starts it again. Sleep leaves their menus.
- The context ring leaves the chat box, and Session Details is always available from the chat header.
- A Needs you command shows Paste in terminal beside Copy when you hover it.
- A one-time tip on the Send button shows Queue with Tab and Compact & Send with Option+Enter.
- OMP approval cards answer only the exact request their dialog shows, and an approval Ghostex can't tie to its request is answered in the terminal, thanks to @cagatay-io.
🎙️ Voice agent
- The greeting is in the call's language (#787), thanks to @cagatay-io.
- A call about all sessions knows them from the start, gives briefer answers and leaves a coordinator's threads out, and the phone's voice screen has a Sessions sheet that moves the call to a session with a tap (#788, ghostex-mobile #71), thanks to @cagatay-io.
- Waiting music plays in voice calls on the phone while the agent works, off by default, with its own volume (ghostex-mobile #70), thanks to @cagatay-io.
- A new call starts fresh; say "pick up where we left off" to bring back the last conversation.
🧩 Extensions and settings
- Staff picks is the Extensions page's first tab, grouped by what each extension is for.
- Session Tags and Cloud Boxes are Staff picks, off by default; anyone who already uses tags or set up a Cloud Box keeps them on. Catch Me Up moves to Extensions, and the Claude Usage and Codex Usage extensions retire, since signing in to Claude or Codex shows usage without them.
- Power User Flags: each Settings page's Advanced fold is now a Power User Flags section, shown when Settings > Experience is Advanced.
📱 On the phone
- Swipe sideways smoothly between a chat's tabs and between Spaces in the sessions list, without fighting the vertical scroll.
🩹 Fixes and polish
- A Native chat whose agent can't start fails its first message instead of waiting for good (#782).
- Ghostex no longer reads Antigravity usage or uses agy for session titles, since Antigravity offers other apps only ACP; Native Antigravity chats need agy 1.5.1 or newer.
- The Browser toolbar puts Open Externally right after the address, a pen for Annotate, and History and Page Size in its ⋯ menu.
- Escape and Return stay inside a text field's right-click menu, and the Send menu shows Tab as Queue's key.
